title: hancornia gardneri

It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Hancornia gardneri include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat a range of health conditions.
